AI: Good morning, Oakwood Veterinary Practice, how can I help you today?
Caller: Hi, I'm really worried — my dog's just eaten a whole bar of dark chocolate about 20 minutes ago. He's a small cockapoo, about 8kg. What should I do?

Caller: It was a 100g bar of 70% dark chocolate. He seems okay at the moment but he's panting a bit and quite restless.
AI: Right, at that dose for an 8kg dog, this is definitely something we need to see urgently. The sooner we can treat him, the better the outcome. I'm going to get him booked in as an emergency right now. Can I take your name please?
Caller: It's James Whitfield. Rufus is the dog's name.
AI: I've found Rufus's records. I'm booking him in as an emergency with Dr Aiden Chen right now. Please bring him straight in — and very importantly, don't try to make him sick yourself, the vet will handle that safely.
Caller: Yes, I've been before. I'll head straight there now. Thank you so much.
AI: I've sent you a confirmation text as well. Drive safely, and we'll have the team ready for Rufus when you arrive. The chocolate toxicity team know he's coming.
